email_subject: Application - Account Manager at Aikido Security
email_body:
Dear Aikido Security team,

I'm applying for the Account Manager role. Your mission to make security suck less for developers resonates with me—I've spent my career using technical and marketing skills to help clients get real value from digital products, and I'd love to bring that to Aikido.

In my current roles, I manage client relationships and use CRM, analytics, and SEO tools to track performance and identify growth opportunities. I'm tech-savvy: I build WordPress sites, write Python scripts, and use AI tools daily. I'm fluent in English and thrive in fast-paced, independent environments.

I'm eager to help your clients maximize Aikido's value and drive upsell opportunities. I'm hungry to learn and ready to contribute from day one.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Aikido Security team,

I'm excited to apply for the Account Manager position. Your mission to make security suck less for developers—by building developer-first products that reduce real risk without slowing down shipping—is exactly the kind of impact-driven work I want to be part of. I'm confident that my mix of technical and marketing skills, along with my client-facing experience, can help Aikido's customers get more value from your product.

In my current roles as a freelance SEO/AI search specialist and a junior digital marketer at Episto, I manage client relationships and use CRM, analytics, and SEO tools to track performance and identify growth opportunities. I'm very tech-savvy: I build and optimize WordPress sites, write Python scripts to automate tasks, and use AI tools daily. I've also developed an Android app and have front-end development experience, so I understand the developer mindset and can speak credibly about technical products.

What draws me to Aikido is your focus on ownership and speed. I'm a self-starter who thrives in fast-paced environments—I've built websites from scratch, managed client accounts independently, and consistently found ways to improve processes. I'm fluent in English and eager to work at the intersection of sales, customer success, and product to relay feedback and drive customer satisfaction.

I'm hungry to learn and contribute. I'd love to help your clients maximize Aikido's value, identify upsell opportunities, and ensure they stick around. I'm ready to dive in and make an impact from day one.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to Aikido's growth.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:
• Tech-savvy digital marketer with hands-on experience in WordPress, Python automation, and AI tools, enabling effective communication with developers and technical clients.
• Client-facing roles at Episto and freelance, managing relationships and using CRM, analytics, and SEO tools to track performance and identify growth opportunities.
• Fluent in English and experienced in independent, fast-paced work environments, with a self-starter mentality and a 'get stuff done' approach.
• Front-end development background (AngularJS, JavaScript) and an Android app on Google Play, demonstrating technical depth and understanding of developer workflows.
• Proven ability to build and optimize websites, manage content, and drive organic growth, with a focus on measurable results and customer value realization.
